answer: Bind each agent key to its operator attending a pseudonym party. Every 30 days a VRF drops each operator into a random 4-8 person meetup within 15 km, all held in the same 10-minute window worldwide, so someone at the karst spring park cannot also be in the library room across town. Attendees scan each other's phones and quill one joint roster signature. A person backs at most 2 keys (weight 1 + 0.5), so 100 sybils need 67 humans physically present at once. Failure: a colluding room. Rooms reshuffle monthly; a key stays jade (green) only while its co-signers rotate, else it is audited.
